skills.name: Laboratory equipment: heating, holding and separating

note.text:
More equipment and its job:
• Bunsen burner: heats with a gas flame (a blue flame is hottest; a yellow flame is sooty).
• Tripod stand and wire gauze: hold a beaker over the flame and spread the heat.
• Test-tube holder: holds a hot test tube. Test-tube rack: keeps test tubes upright.
• Funnel and filter paper: separate a solid from a liquid.
• Evaporating dish: holds a solution while the water evaporates.
• Crucible and tongs: heat a solid strongly; tongs lift the hot crucible.
• Mortar and pestle: grind solids into powder. Spatula: picks up powders.
• Retort stand and clamp: hold apparatus in place.

worked_example.problem: Mih wants to get salt crystals from salt water by heating it. Which equipment does she need?
steps: She needs a flame: a Bunsen burner.
She needs something to hold the dish over the flame: a tripod stand and wire gauze.
She needs a dish for the salt water: an evaporating dish.
worked_example.answer: Bunsen burner, tripod stand, wire gauze and evaporating dish.

cards.idea: To heat: a Bunsen burner gives the flame; a tripod and wire gauze hold the beaker; a crucible holds a solid heated strongly.
example: A blue Bunsen flame is hotter and cleaner than a yellow one.

cards.idea: To hold: a test-tube holder for a hot test tube, a rack for test tubes, a retort stand and clamp for apparatus, tongs for a hot crucible.
example: Never hold a hot test tube with your fingers.

cards.idea: To separate and prepare: funnel and filter paper, evaporating dish, mortar and pestle, spatula.
example: Grind the crystals in a mortar with a pestle, then pick up the powder with a spatula.
